specs.value: In-tank nano CO2 diffuser with a ceramic membrane, attached to the glass with a suction cup
Acrylic (Aquasabi calls it robust acrylic, but its cleaning section mentions PETG)
Tiny under 50 L; S under 100 L; M 100–200 L; L over 200 L

prices.variant: Tiny / S (marked sold out; call to check branch stock)

fits.fact: Choose the size by tank volume: Tiny for nano tanks under 50 L, up to L for tanks over 200 L
Sits inside the tank on a suction cup, so it suits planted tanks that run pressurised CO2 through 4 mm tubing
On every size except Tiny, the acrylic body can be filled with water and used as a bubble counter

usage.fact: Before first use, soak the diffuser in water for about 10 minutes to push out trapped air. Air left inside can cause large bubbles at the membrane's lower edge
Push the 4 mm CO2 line onto the fitting, stick the diffuser to the glass, then set the flow with the regulator
Clean it when algae builds up or the bubbles get noticeably bigger
To clean, soak it in unscented household bleach mixed 1:1 with water for about 30–60 minutes, then rinse well. Never mix bleach with vinegar
Thủy Sinh Tím gives a longer soak of 1–4 hours, or overnight, in 1:1 bleach, followed by several rinses
A retailer says some larger bubbles are normal at first, shrinking after about 24 hours of continuous use and gone within about 3 days

issues.fact: The ceramic gets clogged by algae and slowly starts making bigger bubbles, so it needs regular bleach cleaning
Large bubbles in the first days usually mean trapped air or a membrane that is still breaking in, not a fault
Membrane diameters differ slightly between listings (S is given as 13, 13.7 or 14 mm), and one page names the body material as both acrylic and PETG
Reviews are positive about the fine bubbles. Because the body is plastic, not glass, it is less likely to snap when you pull the tubing off for cleaning
Many Vietnamese shops list the product as out of stock or running low, so check stock before ordering
Greendeal also sells a 'Diffuser Mate' version at slightly higher prices, but its page gives no specs

alternatives.model: External CO2 Diffuser (inline, M 12/16 mm / L 16/22 mm)
alternatives.why: Fits on the canister filter outlet hose, so nothing sits inside the tank and CO2 is dissolved more evenly in larger tanks. Thủy Sinh Bích Phương lists it at about 360,000₫. It needs a minimum working pressure of 1.5 bar
A sturdier stainless steel diffuser on a tall stand. Shaquarium lists it at about 295,000₫, and its ceramic membrane can be replaced
A cheaper generic acrylic or glass nano diffuser sold by Vietnamese shops such as Ylang Aquarium
